python3 - <<'PY'
import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
load=lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
a=load('audit.json'); fields=load('fields.json'); m=load('manifest.json')
inputs={'source':load('source.json'),'verification':load('verification.json'),'probe':load('probe-results.json')}
def get(obj,p):
    for part in p.split('/')[1:]:
        part=part.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        obj=obj[int(part)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[part]
    return obj
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['inputSha256']
assert a['reviewedPointers']==[f['pointer'] for f in fields]
assert len(set(a['reviewedPointers']))==len(fields)
for f in fields: assert get(m,f['pointer'])==f['value']
for f in a['findings']:
    for e in f['evidence']:
        v=get(inputs[e['file']],e['pointer'])
        assert e['quote'] in v if 'quote' in e else e['value']==v
for e in a['edits']:
    assert e['pointer'] in a['reviewedPointers']
    assert all(any(f['id']==i and f['pointer']==e['pointer'] for f in a['findings']) for i in e['findingIds'])
assert all(any(f['id'] in e['findingIds'] for e in a['edits']) for f in a['findings'])
print('Verified manifest hash, all 17 fields, evidence references, and edit links.')
PY
